approved_scope.description: KNOW-29 roll-up copies never moves tracked session records (#165)
acceptance_criteria: At the move into done with the librarian on, archived sessions beyond the five newest are copied byte for byte into the vault (hard link sharing bytes) and remain in .chough/sessions/archive/ unchanged; the report names them under copied. A vault attachment with identical bytes means nothing to do; different bytes leave both sides untouched and are reported. The legacy-anchor holder never rolls. Tracked session records never leave the tree, whether or not knowledge/ is committed.
